repos.name: deepseek-ai/DeepInfer

Focuses on memory efficiency and throughput for high-demand AI infrastructure.

repos.name: twentyhq/twenty
repos.description: The open alternative to Salesforce, designed for AI.
repos.one_liner: An open-source, AI-native CRM platform designed to replace Salesforce.
bullets: Full-stack TypeScript application utilizing a modern web architecture.
Integrates AI agents directly into the sales workflow for automated data entry and lead scoring.
Provides a modular infrastructure that allows for custom data modeling and self-hosting.
Ideal for fintech and B2B companies requiring data sovereignty and custom CRM logic.

repos.name: Louis-CFM/coucou
repos.description: A tiny friend in your Mac's notch and on your iPhone that keeps an eye on your AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and more. Approve from the notch or your Lock Screen.
repos.one_liner: A macOS and iOS utility that monitors and manages AI coding agents from your menu bar.
bullets: Swift-based native macOS app with deep integration into the system notch and iOS Lock Screen.
Acts as a centralized control plane for agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.
Provides real-time approval workflows for agentic actions, enhancing security and oversight.
Essential devtool for developers managing multiple autonomous AI coding sessions.

repos.name: ikow/php2shell-poc
repos.description: CVE-2026-109618/109619 PHP session.upload_progress Exploit Research — POC & Analysis
repos.one_liner: A research-focused Proof of Concept for critical PHP session upload vulnerabilities.
bullets: Python-based exploit research tool targeting CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.
Analyzes session.upload_progress mechanisms to identify remote code execution vectors.
Critical for security professionals auditing web infrastructure and fintech backend stacks.
Provides deep insight into PHP engine vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies.

repos.name: mmparko/dsh-purge
repos.description: DeepSeek Harness 破甲 (mirror of YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge) — 上游即将删库，此为本仓库全量镜像：含全部分支/73 个 tag/完整提交历史。原作者署名与二开要求见 README 署名章节。
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive mirror and preservation repository for the DeepSeek Harness project.
bullets: Maintains full commit history, branches, and tags for critical AI infrastructure tooling.
Ensures availability of open-source research code that is prone to sudden upstream deletion.
Serves as a vital resource for developers building on top of DeepSeek's ecosystem.
Demonstrates the importance of version control and archival in the fast-moving AI devtools space.
